name: Cajun Seasoning
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical seasoning amounts, though some commercial blends may contain garlic or onion powder - check ingredients.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully as some commercial blends contain garlic or onion powder
Make your own blend with paprika, cayenne, oregano, thyme, and black pepper
Start with small amounts to test tolerance, especially if you're sensitive to spicy foods
Store in airtight container to maintain potency and prevent moisture
alternatives: Homemade spice blend with cumin and paprika
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from paprika and cayenne
Contains capsaicin which may boost metabolism
Low in sodium compared to many seasoning salts
